title: digitaria ischaemum f. gracillima
intro: Digitaria ischaemum f. gracillima, commonly known as Cynodon dactylon or grassy leafy wind grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, wounds, and digestive problems. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Digitaria ischaemum f. gracillima include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
